messages.subject: Look for markers with distorted segregation patterns
parts:
Hi Dr. Broman,

I have one question about distorted segregation markers. 
In your sample "mapthis"
>todrop<-rownames(gt[gt$P.value<1e-10,])

How did you set the threshold as 1e-10?
If I use F3, the expected genotypes(%) AA:37.5  AB:25  BB:37.5 , what value I should use? I don't understand. 
Thanks a lot. 

Sincerely,
Chen

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Look for markers with distorted segregation patterns
parts:
I didn't use any formal method for choosing that cut-off.
You might consider a Bonferroni correction, say 0.05/m where m is the number of markers.

karl
